title: MAGIC ENGLISH BEGINNER — WORLD 5: A1 COMMUNICATION ADVENTURE
description: A high-density A1 world focused on connected sentences, practical conversations, simple past and future exposure, reading comprehension, listening for detail, guided writing and confident speaking.

missions.title: Question Power
speaking: Use complete answers, not single words.
listening: Identify the question word and key answer.

missions.title: My Week
speaking: Describe your week from Monday to Sunday.
listening: Follow a weekly schedule and identify six details.
writing: Write 12 connected sentences about your week.

missions.title: Yesterday
speaking: Put five past events in order.
listening: Understand a short story about yesterday.
missions.challenge: Tell a 60-second story about yesterday without reading.

missions.title: Last Weekend Adventure
reading: Read a 180-word A1 weekend story and identify the main events.
listening: Identify who, where, when and what happened.
speaking: Retell the weekend story using sequence words.
writing: Write a short paragraph about your last weekend.

missions.title: Plans for Tomorrow
grammar: present continuous for simple arrangements exposure
speaking: Talk about five plans for tomorrow.
Ask a friend about their plans.
listening: Identify future plans, time and place.
missions.challenge: Plan a full day with a partner in English.

missions.title: Invitations and Replies
speaking: Invite a friend to three activities.
Accept or politely decline an invitation.

missions.title: Comparing Things
speaking: Compare two animals, two places and two objects.
reading: Read short comparisons and identify the reason for each choice.

missions.title: My Town and My Favorite Place
speaking: Describe your favorite place and explain why.
listening: Match a spoken description to a place.
writing: Write a 100-word description of a favorite place.

missions.title: Travel Check-In
listening: Identify destination, time, room and request.
missions.challenge: Complete a travel conversation using only English prompts.

missions.title: Real-Life Conversation Lab
speaking: Ask follow-up questions instead of stopping after one answer.
listening: Understand a 2-minute A1 dialogue and identify eight details.
missions.challenge: Complete school, shopping and travel role-plays in one mission.

missions.title: Reading Detective
reading: Guess the meaning of familiar-context vocabulary.
speaking: Explain the story in five sentences.
missions.challenge: Solve a reading mystery using only information from the text.

missions.title: Listening for Details
listening: Understand clear natural A1 speech at normal speed.
Catch names, numbers, times, prices and places.
Separate key details from extra information.
speaking: Answer listening questions in full sentences.
missions.challenge: Complete gist → detail → recall → spoken response rounds.

missions.title: Writing Builder
writing: Edit spelling, punctuation and verb forms.
reading: Analyze a model paragraph and identify its structure.
missions.challenge: Turn notes into a complete connected text without copying a model.

missions.title: Speak for Two Minutes
speaking: Speak for two minutes about yourself, your week or a memorable day.
listening: Listen to a two-minute student talk and identify the structure.
missions.challenge: Speak continuously with no translation support.

missions.title: Problem Solver
listening: Identify problem, cause and suggested solution.
missions.challenge: Solve five everyday problems through role-play.

missions.title: English-Only Mission
listening: Understand short natural questions and follow-ups.
reading: Read short A1 messages without translating every word.
writing: Write quick answers in complete sentences.
missions.challenge: Complete the entire mission without translation prompts.

missions.title: Story Studio
listening: Listen to a short story and identify beginning, middle and end.
speaking: Change one event and tell the new ending.
missions.challenge: Create a beginning, problem, solution and ending in English.

missions.title: Conversation Challenge
speaking: Keep a conversation going for three minutes.
listening: Understand a natural A1 dialogue with repetition and clarification.
missions.challenge: Complete a conversation without ending it after one question.

missions.title: A1 Mission Simulation
listening: Understand a 3-minute clear A1 scenario and extract key information.
reading: Read a 300-word practical text and answer detail questions.
speaking: Complete two role-plays and a 90-second independent talk.
missions.challenge: Complete all four skills with one continuous real-life scenario.

missions.title: WORLD 5 FINAL MASTER QUEST — A1 COMMUNICATION POWER
listening: Understand a 3-minute clear natural A1 conversation or story, including gist and important details.
reading: Read a 300–350 word A1 text and identify main idea, sequence, details and simple inference.
speaking: Complete travel, shopping and problem-solving role-plays.
writing: Write 150–180 connected words about a personal experience or future plan.
missions.challenge: Complete a full English-only A1 simulation with listening, reading, speaking, writing and real-life communication.
missions.mastery_target: Learner communicates in familiar everyday situations with connected A1 sentences, understands clear normal-speed speech, reads short connected texts, tells simple stories and writes a coherent personal paragraph.

world_review.mastery: Strong A1 communication with increasing independence, connected speech, practical role-play, basic past/future expression and sustained everyday conversation.
